SELECT s.State, s.SOCType, COUNT(*) AS schools, COUNT(t.cds) AS matched, SUM(t.NumTstTakr = 0) AS recorded_zero
FROM main.schools AS s
LEFT JOIN main.satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' AND s.EILName = 'High School'
GROUP BY s.State, s.SOCType
